description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER carries the RFC 1497 magic cookie 99,130,83,99 in the first four octets of the 'options' field (RFC 2131 §3 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The magic cookie {99, 130, 83, 99} (i.e. 0x63825363) is what tells receivers 'this BOOTP message uses the DHCP options format'. Without it, the rest of the options blob is undefined. RFC 2131 §3 makes the cookie mandatory.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • options[0..3] == {0x63, 0x82, 0x53, 0x63}   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First four bytes of the options field are the RFC 1497 magic cookie.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_magic_cookie_invalid — DISCOVER missing or has wrong magic cookie
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DISCOVER carries the RFC 1497 magic cookie — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
